newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield to make U.S. announcement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield to make U.S. announcement.

text.p: The chairman of property group Westfield Holdings Ltd, Frank Lowy, would make an important announcement about Westfield's U.S. operations on Wednesday, Westfield said.
Westfield Holdings owns 49.1 percent of Westfield America Trust and the Lowy family own 11 percent of Westfield America.

In November, the Lowy family announced it had sold its stake down to 11 percent from 19.4 percent, but it said then that neither Westfield or the Lowy family would further cut their holdings of Westfield America in the next 12 months.
Westfield said a news conference had been set in Sydney for 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT) to make the announcement.
